title: X.509 DTLS handshake over TSCH on EMULATED nRF52840-DK (reproduce the hardware cert-flight stall)

test.description: Server (node 1) = RPL root + TSCH coordinator; client (node 2) associates, resolves the root, and does an X.509 DTLS handshake. UDGM LOSSLESS: no radio loss, so if the handshake still stalls it is the same 6LoWPAN-over-TSCH cert-flight bug seen on hardware -- reproduced in the emulator for fast iteration. PASSES if the client prints its handshake-1 PASSED line.
